create_alerting_hanging_request_check: create an AlertingHangingRequestCheck instance to monitor LLM API hanging requests via Slack
add_request_to_hanging_request_check: add a request to the hanging request cache for periodic hanging request monitoring
send_alerts_for_hanging_requests: send Slack alerts for all requests that have exceeded the hanging request threshold
check_for_hanging_requests: run a background task that periodically checks for hanging LLM requests and sends alerts
send_hanging_request_alert: send a Slack alert with model, API base, key alias, and team alias details for a hanging request
